name: Protein–RNA docking benchmark v2.0
description: A curated non-redundant dataset for evaluating protein–RNA docking algorithms and their docking accuracy on experimentally solved complexes.
evaluation_method: root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) and docking success rate at predefined thresholds (e.g., native-like RMSD cutoff)
general_score_metric: interface RMSD / docking success rate (percentage of complexes meeting RMSD threshold)
reputation: Well-regarded in structural bioinformatics as a curated non-redundant benchmark for assessing protein–RNA docking algorithms.
notes: Small, specialized non-LLM benchmark limited to experimentally solved complexes; performance is highly sensitive to input quality and protocol; not directly comparable to general protein modeling benchmarks.
